def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); orbs=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            o=tuple(sorted({(i,j),(i,w-1-j),(h-1-i,j),(h-1-i,w-1-j)}))
            if o not in seen:
                seen.add(o); orbs.append(o)
    # colors that never form a unanimous orbit
    allc=set(x for r in g for x in r)
    bad=set()
    for c in allc:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        if all(len({g[i][j] for i,j in orbs and [x for x in orbs if (i,j) in x][0]})>1 for i,j in cells):
